note: U063 navigable-surface census. One contract per navigable surface the code holds; tests/unit/surface-census.test.mjs derives the surfaces (WORKSPACES of src/js/ui/app.js, the data-osc-modes elements, role=tab and exps.panel views and dialogs of src/index.html, HASH_DOMAINS of src/js/ui/navigation.js) and refuses a surface without an entry and an entry without a surface; tests/browser/surface-census.cjs holds it to the running page. reachedFrom of a panel or subview is the data-osc-modes of the element that holds it (what the phone layout shows; at 1280 px and wider the Playground lays every instrument panel out as an overview). charts names the chart hosts of a panel, which are K053's census (tests/unit/chart-host-census.json) and are not described here. The debt is the entries whose deepLink is null or whose tests are empty; its count only shrinks against this file's git history. A <placeholder> in a deep link stands for a stored record's id.

evidenceClasses.measured: values captured from a real input of this device (the microphone, MEASURE), relative unless a level calibration applies
evidenceClasses.derived: values computed from the instrument's own signal, the running audio context or a model (analyser views, computed responses)
evidenceClasses.inferred: values estimated from other values by a stated method where the method may be wrong
evidenceClasses.recorded: values read from a record: a stored experiment, definition, finding, preset or project, or a cited published dataset
evidenceClasses.planned: what will play or run: a pattern, a sequence, a Studio graph or timeline, an envelope
evidenceClasses.test-context: values of the TEST CONTEXT digital loopback, never of a physical input
evidenceClasses.none: controls, text or a form with no data shown as a result
